name: Neem Shield Bio-Pesticide
dosage: 2 to 3 ml per Litre of water (approx 300-400 ml/acre)
composition: Azadirachtin 1% EC, Neem Oil 90% w/w, Emulsifier 9% w/w
usage_notes: Spray during evening hours. Effective preventative and anti-feedant bio-pesticide. Organic certified.
precautions: Keep away from children and pets. Do not mix with strong alkaline chemicals.

name: Urea 46% Nitrogen
dosage: 45-50 kg per acre split into 2-3 applications during vegetative growth phase
usage_notes: Primary source of nitrogen for lush green vegetative growth. Apply after basal dose when soil has adequate moisture.
precautions: Avoid excessive application which promotes fungal infections and lodging. Store in dry place.

name: DAP 18-46-0 (Di-Ammonium Phosphate)
dosage: 50 kg per acre as basal dose at the time of sowing/transplanting
composition: Ammoniacal Nitrogen 18%, Water Soluble Phosphate 41.4%, Total P2O5 46%
usage_notes: Crucial for root establishment, tillering, and early plant vigor. Place 3-5 cm below seed level.
precautions: Do not mix directly with seed without soil barrier. Avoid mixing with lime or calcium nitrate.

name: MOP 60% (Muriate of Potash)
dosage: 25-40 kg per acre depending on crop requirement
usage_notes: Improves fruit size, drought resistance, disease tolerance, and grain filling.
precautions: Contains chloride; restrict heavy usage in chloride-sensitive crops like Tobacco or Tea.

name: NPK 19-19-19 Water Soluble
dosage: 5 grams per Litre of water (1 kg per acre for drip/foliar spray)
usage_notes: Balanced foliar spray for early vegetative and flowering boost. Quick leaf absorption.
precautions: Spray during early morning or late evening. Do not mix with Copper or Sulphur fungicides.

name: Chlorpyrifos 20% EC
dosage: 2 ml per Litre of water (for foliage) or 1.5 to 2 Litres per acre (soil drench for termites)
composition: Chlorpyrifos Technical 20.00% w/w, Emulsifier 6.00% w/w, Solvent q.s.
usage_notes: Broad-spectrum organophosphate insecticide with contact, stomach, and vapor action.
precautions: Toxic to bees and aquatic life. Wear protective gloves and face mask during application.

name: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL
dosage: 0.5 ml per Litre of water (approx 50-100 ml per acre)
usage_notes: Systemic insecticide for sucking pest control. Fast translaminar action protecting new foliage.
precautions: Do not apply during peak flowering phase to protect pollinators.

name: Coragen Insecticide
dosage: 60 ml per acre in 150-200 Litres of water
usage_notes: Advanced anthranilic diamide insecticide. Excellent residual control and rain-fastness within 2 hours.
precautions: Follow strict dosage. Rotate with different chemical classes to prevent resistance.

name: Mancozeb 75% WP Fungicide
dosage: 2 to 2.5 grams per Litre of water (600-800 g/acre)
composition: Mancozeb a.i. 75% w/w, Inert fillers 25% w/w
usage_notes: Contact protective fungicide supplying essential Zinc and Manganese trace elements.
precautions: Ensure complete coverage of foliage. Do not spray right before harvest (PHI: 7-14 days).

name: Saaf Fungicide (Carbendazim + Mancozeb)
dosage: 2 grams per Litre of water or 250-500 g/acre for seed treatment
usage_notes: Dual contact and systemic action fungicide. Excellent for seed treatment and foliar blight control.
precautions: Do not mix with alkaline substances. Wear eye protection while mixing powder.

name: Trichoderma Viride Bio-Fungicide
dosage: 1 kg per acre mixed with 100 kg farmyard manure or 5-10 g/kg seed treatment
usage_notes: Beneficial bio-control fungus that parasitizes soil-borne pathogenic fungi and boosts root vigor.
precautions: Do not mix or spray chemical fungicides within 7 days of bio-fungicide application.

name: Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate 21%
dosage: 10-15 kg per acre for soil application or 5 g/L with 2.5 g lime for foliar spray
usage_notes: Cures Khaira disease in rice and white bud in maize. Vital for enzyme activation.
precautions: Never mix directly with DAP or single superphosphate (SSP) in spray tank as precipitate forms.

name: Single Super Phosphate (SSP) 16%
dosage: 100-150 kg per acre as basal fertilizer
composition: Water Soluble P2O5 16%, Elemental Sulphur 11%, Calcium 19%
usage_notes: Multi-nutrient fertilizer supplying Phosphorus, Sulphur, and Calcium essential for oil synthesis.
precautions: Incorporate thoroughly into moist soil during seedbed preparation.

name: Emamectin Benzoate 5% SG
dosage: 80-100 grams per acre (approx 0.5 g per Litre of water)
usage_notes: Naturally derived macrocyclic lactone insecticide with translaminar activity on caterpillars.
precautions: PHI of 3 days for harvest. High rain-fastness.

name: Humic Acid 98% Potassium Humate
dosage: 1-2 grams per Litre of water or 500g per acre via drip irrigation
usage_notes: Enhances soil microbial activity, white root development, and nutrient cation exchange capacity.
precautions: Compatible with most fertilizers. Dissolve fully in water before pouring into spray tank.
